learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to look at our family and things around us to tell if they are tall, short, thick, or thin!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at Lina and her Papa. Papa is tall and Lina is short. Who is the tallest person in your beautiful family?
Lina's grandma has long hair. Lina's brother has short hair. Look at your crayons. Which one is long and which one is short?
A big old tree trunk is very thick. A small green plant stem is thin. We can check our storybooks too!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Family Height Line
fun_activity.instructions: Ask everyone in your house to stand in a straight line! Put the shortest person in the front and the tallest person at the back.

quick_recap: ⭐ We can compare people to see who is tall and who is short.
⭐ We use fun math words like thick, thin, long, and short to describe everyday things!
